title: Four-Column Master Inventory Bands
summary: Reformats each food family into a shallow horizontal band with Fresh, Frozen, Canned, and Instant/Jar columns.
behavior: Uses four equal columns for Fresh, Frozen, Canned, and Instant/Jar product forms.
Places HAVE | BUY in the header of every inventory-type column.
Keeps product form and unit on one compact line.
Reduces quantity-counter text to 8px and counter height to 19px.
Uses 21px product rows and one short Notes line beneath the columns.
Reflows to two columns on iPad-width screens and one column on narrow phones.
